classificationTaxonomy.C0: Non-sync incident (matched keyword but is normal bug/feat — counted but not a sync mishap)
classificationTaxonomy.C1a: Target-only delta overwritten by sync; community/maintainer waited for us to fix (high severity)
classificationTaxonomy.C1b: Maintainer self-quickfixed in clowder-ai after our overwrite (medium severity, but still a sync overwrite event)
classificationTaxonomy.C2: Ledger false-complete (recorded != absorbed-complete; LL-067/#290 covered #276 family)
classificationTaxonomy.C3: Home-side regression exported via sync (cat-cafe演进 broke shared behavior, sync surfaced to public — invisible to 3-way gate)
classificationTaxonomy.C4: Export/sanitizer transform regression (sanitizer mask leaks, allowlist gaps, preserveGlobalCascade, dir-prefix exclude)
classificationTaxonomy.C5: Release/package/docs drift (.env.example stale, brand violation, doc desync after sync)

gateCoverage.covered_by_v1_public_delta_gate: Phase A classifier + baseline resolver would detect this if wired (C1a/C1b/C2)
gateCoverage.requires_contract_registry: Phase B Contract Registry would catch home regression (C3)
gateCoverage.requires_transform_gate: F238 brand dictionary + Inbound Guard / sanitizer audit needed (C4)
gateCoverage.requires_release_gate: Release tag check + docs sync gate (C5)

stats.ownerReportedNote: zts212653 (CVO) himself filed #680/#959/#966/+ — owner-pain signal is high. Sync overwrite is not just collaborator complaint.

keyFindings: **C3 dominates (7/13 真sync incidents)** — Home regression exported via sync is the most common true incident class. **Phase A V1 gate can NOT catch C3** (no target-side delta when target had nothing to overwrite). Phase B Contract Registry is structural necessity, not optional.
**C1a is rare but flagship (2/13)** — #723 (F190 17-item) and #906 (github plugin.yaml). When it happens, it's catastrophic (#723 is double regression). These two are the AC-A5 anchor fixtures.

**C4/C5 are F238-territory (4/13)** — sanitizer/transform/exclude/brand drift sub-class. F251 Task 1-4 scope NOT this; F238 brand-dictionary + reverse-check guard (`docs_runtime_assets_allowlist`) covers.

**zts212653 owner-reports** (#680/#959/#966) signal **F251 痛点 is real for owner**, not just collaborator complaint. AC-B1 high-priority contracts should include kimi temp leak + provider_capability dual-handler + F190 link affordance.

**test-gap is THE common axis (9/13)** — Most sync incidents have a test-gap component. AC-B2 Contract Registry execution must include test-gap registry entries, not just user-visible behavior — backing-invariant tests are equally important.
